verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a public API for MoQ relays: relays can be created and managed through the API, and additional tokens with expiration times can be created through it. A platform OpenAPI spec is also reachable. However, the evidence shows only a few operations and not the full API reference, and the product is in beta. Missing for 10: detailed endpoint-level documentation of the MoQ API surface (list, update and delete operations, token revocation), confirmation that MoQ endpoints appear in the OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Cloudflare MoQ relays are available through the [Cloudflare dashboard ↗︎](https://dash.cloudflare.com/) and the [API](/api/resources/moq).
You can create additional tokens and set expiration times using the [API](/api/resources/moq).
Cloudflare returns a relay ID and two default tokens: one that can publish and subscribe, and one that can only subscribe.
